9:16 vertical version, modern Oriental female dreamland three-dimensional papercut art. The theme is "She opens a skylight between the mountains and rivers of Guilin".

An Oriental adult woman, visual age about 24 years old, stands alone on a circular viewing platform. The figure is small, serving as an emotional anchor in the vast landscape. She looks at a giant circular paper window in the distance. Her hair is black, and she wears a multi-layered paper art long dress in cyan and moon-white with hollow patterns.

The dream carrier is a giant circular paper window floating deep in the peaks. The composition uses a "peek into a dream through a window" style. The middle ground is a wide, quiet paper-carved lake made of multi-layered paper sheets. The lake is flanked by Guilin-style karst paper-carved peaks. The peaks are layered with visible paper fibers and fine gold outlines.

The upper part of the picture is a huge circular paper-carved skylight. Through the window, one can see even more distant paper-carved peaks and clouds, creating a second world. Colors are mainly cyan, ink blue, moon white, and light gold. The light is soft morning light shining from behind the circular window. The texture emphasizes real paper art: fiber, thickness, manual cut edges, and soft layer shadows. Overall mood: Ethereal, quiet, and vast.
